turns.assessment: The hard, simultaneous all-channel loss is localized to the first physical span leaving S14 toward S04: OSC_LOS occurs on oms.S14-S04.span0 (O126), followed by AMP_INPUT_LOS at the next amplifier (O1). The corresponding reverse-direction span also loses OSC and the S14 preamp loses input (O125/O123), indicating both fibres of the cable are interrupted. Stable amplifier pump currents argue strongly against amplifier failure; the paired directional loss rules out a single OMS input connector.

proposals.rationale: E23 is the outgoing representation of the physical cable section adjacent to S14. Its OSC loss, downstream amplifier input LOS, and simultaneous loss of the reverse fibre are the documented signature of a fibre-cable cut and directly interrupt svc327.

An extreme added loss could also suppress both payload and OSC, but simultaneous failure of the paired reverse fibre and other adjacent links is much more characteristic of excavation cutting a shared duct.
